sysinfo.title: System Information
sysinfo.featureFastDesc: Real-time code execution and debugging, no firmware updates required! Works in all modern browsers, and on iOS and Android via the PWA.
sysinfo.featureEditorDesc: Agentic code editor for MicroPython with syntax highlighting, file management, and seamless deployment to connected devices.  Just describe what you want, and the agent will do the rest.
sysinfo.featureScriptoDesc: Script Objects are the ultimate device customization tool. Choose from a library of ScriptOs to get started, or roll your own with the Smart Python Editor.
sysinfo.featureExtensionsDesc: Add major new system features at the touch of a button.  Load Extensions from the Scripto Studio library, such as OVMS, OpenInverter, Dala's Battery Emulator  or create your own that can be shared with the community.
sysinfo.featureManagementDesc: Connect and manage devices, configure board settings, manage user credentials, network settings and more. Access your devices from anywhere in the world, on any device over a secure P2P VPN
sysinfo.featureMonitoringDesc: Advanced visual debugger with single Step and Watchpoints, together with Live system monitoring and performance metrics make debugging embedded applications easier than ever.

agentPanel.title: Use with an agent
agentPanel.intro: An agent on your computer can operate this board: run code, move files, and use the tools your installed apps provide. Studio stays connected alongside it.
agentPanel.watch: What an agent does shows up in the terminal and the Logs window. Stop, above the editor, breaks whatever it's running and stops its background tasks and apps.
agentPanel.connectFirst: Connect to your board, and what to paste appears here.
agentPanel.claudeCodeHint: Paste this into a terminal, once, from any folder. Then start a new Claude Code session and ask it something like "plot a sine wave on the board's terminal". Its code and output appear in the terminal here.
agentPanel.tokenHint: The copied text includes this board's agent token, which lets whoever has it run code on the board.
agentPanel.otherAgentsHint: Any MCP client that speaks HTTP can use this address, with this header:
agentPanel.noInstallHint: PFC runs an agent on the board itself, so this computer needs nothing. Install it from Apps.

home.keyHint: It stays in this browser, in a separate frame that Studio's pages and Apps can't read. Using it is billed to your OpenRouter account.
home.keyBadShape: That isn't an OpenRouter key. Those start with sk-or-.
home.keyRejected: OpenRouter didn't accept this key. Check it's your OpenRouter key (sk-or-…).
home.typeSomething: Type what the board should do
home.frameMissing: Studio couldn't load the frame that holds your API key.
home.notRun: This wasn't run, because the reply was cut short.
home.cutShort: The reply was too long and got cut short. Ask for less at once.
home.tooManyRounds: The agent stopped after a lot of steps. Tell it to carry on if it should.
home.compacted: Earlier work was summarised to make room.
home.compactFailed: Couldn't summarise this chat to make room. Try again, or start a new chat.
home.interrupted: The page closed while the agent was working, so it stopped there.

platformUpdate.checking: Checking ScriptoHub for a platform update…
platformUpdate.frameworkDetail: Only botIQ's files change, and the firmware stays. The board restarts once they're in.
platformUpdate.firmwareDetail: New firmware ({size}) and botIQ's files. The board restarts on them, and keeps them once its apps run again.
platformUpdate.needsUsb: This board has one app slot, so its firmware is updated over USB.
platformUpdate.confirm: Update this board to {version}? It restarts at the end, and its apps stop until it's back.
platformUpdate.heldBackBotiq: Held back: {app} needs botIQ {range}, and {version} is outside it.
platformUpdate.heldBackModules: Held back: {app} needs {modules} in the firmware, and {version} doesn't have it.
platformUpdate.appsUnknown: Held back: Studio couldn't check what the installed apps need ({why}).
platformUpdate.startRefused: The board didn't start the update: {why}
platformUpdate.restarting: Restarting on {version}. Studio reconnects when the board is back.
platformUpdate.trial: On trial: the board keeps {version} once its apps run again, within two minutes.
platformUpdate.lost: Studio lost the board while it restarted. Connect again to see how the update to {version} ended.
platformUpdate.putBack: {version} was put back: {why}. The board runs what it ran before.
platformUpdate.failed: The update to {version} stopped: {why}. Nothing on the board changed.
platformUpdate.cancelled: Update cancelled. Updating again picks up the download where it stopped.
platformUpdate.noNewerRelease: ScriptoHub has no newer platform release for this board.
